notes_for_editor: Brief checked: FFLA lists Loc 1 as Tower Gone at 31.25794, -93.82197 in Sabine County; no correction needed. No build, height, design, staffing, fire or fate record in the sources read (FFLA Texas list, TSHA Yellowpine entry, tnlandforms list) or in two searches. Find a Grave page for Yellowpine Cemetery (cemetery 2171302) returned 403 and was not used; its search snippet gives 'Fire Tower Cemetery' as an alternate name, which is only a lead and was not quoted. An anyplaceamerica snippet names a 'Yellowpine Lookout' (USGS ID 1383006) that was not read. Both may tie the name to a tower site; check before expanding. The story does not link the community to the tower beyond the shared name. Confidence low.
